description: Fetches restaurant information (contact, hours) and browses the Shopify catalog (gift cards, books, products) for Restaurant KEI in Paris by chef Kei Kobayashi.

function.description:
The function to call. Available values:
  - fetch_home_page    Fetch restaurant info (address, hours, contact) from the home page
  - get_contact_info   Get structured contact information for the restaurant
  - list_products      List all products (gift cards, books, menus, etc.)
  - get_product        Get details for a specific product by handle or ID
  - list_collections   List all product collections
  - get_collection     Get details for a specific collection by handle

lang.description: Language code for home page (default: 'en', also supports 'fr')

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return for list_products/list_collections (default: 50, max: 250)

handle.description: Product or collection handle/slug for get_product or get_collection

product_id.description: Shopify product ID (alternative to handle for get_product)
